contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus, or possibly a contemporary copy of a nummus, of Constantius II, AD355-361 (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Reverse shows Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Mint is illegible. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse is also illegible
